column1: # spec/01-engine.md 13.12 (rows S01 to S84, 1.1.0): the worked examples of the typo correction, hand written from
# the spec's table, one row per spec row in the spec's order (TypoCorrectionExampleTests.tableMatchesTheSpec keeps the
# ids and the `expected` text equal to the spec). Read from the checkout by VietnameseEngineDataTests with the bundled
#   setup         - | code (the code context) | off (typoCorrection off) | never:<word> (never-correct list) |
#                 keep:<word> (keep-as-typed list) | macro:<trigger>=<expansion> | after:<id> (that row first, then
#                 its signal's word on the never-correct list, then these keys in a new engine)
#   keys          from an empty field, then the committing key; TSV escapes \s space at an end, \n Return, \t Tab;
#   expected      the field with typoCorrection on (the spec's text column)
#   expected_off  the field the 1.0 rules leave with typoCorrection off (the spec's "What decided" column), checked
#                 against the current engine by rowsWithTheSwitchOffMatchThe1_0Engine
#   decision      the last commit's CommitDecision with the switch on: corrected(<rule>), kept(<rule>), restored(<rule>)
#                 or macro; for a correction, <rule> is the rule of 8.1 that decides the token with the switch off
#   signal        neverCorrect(<word>) when an output carries it with the switch on, otherwise -
#   note          free text, except q10:<text> (S23, S24) and q11:<text> (S26): the field under the other answer to
#                 open question Q10 or Q11 of spec section 15 (CorrectionPolicy)
